question: In February 2022, Patanjali launched a co-branded contactless credit card with which bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab National Bank**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In February 2022, Patanjali launched a co-branded contactless credit card with **Punjab National Bank (PNB)**.
 
• The launch of this credit card aims to provide a **seamless and efficient payment solution for Patanjali's customers**.
 
• This collaboration between Patanjali and PNB is expected to leverage the strengths of both organizations to offer a unique value proposition to the cardholders.
 
• The cardholders can avail of various benefits and rewards on purchases made using the co-branded credit card.
 
• This initiative is part of Patanjali's broader strategy to expand its footprint in the financial services sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Patanjali Ayurved Limited is an Indian multinational consumer packaged goods company, based in **Haridwar**, India.
 
• Founded by Baba Ramdev and Acharya Balkrishna in 2006, the company has grown to become one of the leading **FMCG brands** in India.
 
• Punjab National Bank (PNB) is a **state-owned commercial bank in India**, established in **1894**.
 
• PNB provides a range of banking and financial services to its customers, including retail banking, corporate banking, and treasury services.
 
• The co-branded credit card with Patanjali is one of the many initiatives taken by PNB to diversify its product offerings and enhance customer experience.
